verdict.rationale: Rippling positions its HR employee record as the single source of truth (29) and says identity draws on that same system with no SCIM lag (23). It claims to automatically provision accounts, update access, permissions and groups, and revoke access as roles change or people leave (1, 3, 18, 31). Downstream targets include AD/LDAP directories and custom SCIM/SAML apps (4), which covers joiner, mover and leaver flows into both the directory and app assignments. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how HR attribute changes map to directory and app assignment rules (e.g. AD write-back mechanics), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
